de1.P2.C4.ly_do: a Dung (4 dinh cho 12 vecto co thu tu); b Dung (goc (AB,BC) = 180 do - 60 do = 120 do trong tu dien deu); c Dung (BE = 2/3 BC + 1/3 BD voi CE = (1/3)CD); d Dung theo phan khai trien da thay (BE = AC + (1/3)CD - AB, dung dai so). Entry cu chi ghi chu ma khong dat tf_ans, de luu tf_ans rong.
de1.P2.C4.ghi_chu: De dan goc van vo (chi con anh image15.emf va manh loi giai); menh de d trong file bi cat cut o giua khai trien nen dap an d chi can cu vao phan khai trien da thay — can de goc de khoi phuc day du cau dan.

de1.P2.C6.ly_do: a Dung (khoang bien thien cua Chi = 40-15 = 25 phut); cac manh loi giai da doi chieu (Q1 Binh = 345/16, Q1 Chi = 18,75, Q3 Chi = 27,5, khoang tu phan vi Chi = 8,75, trung binh Binh = 157/6, phuong sai Binh = 314/9) chua du de khoi phuc b, c, d.
de1.P2.C6.ghi_chu: Cac menh de b ('O ban Binh.'), c ('O ban Chi.') va d ('Thoi gian trung binh ban Binh tap the duc buoi sang la') deu bi cat cut, khong co khang dinh de xet — can de goc.
